formulas.text: all r in Relationship, e in r.ends. e.entity.language == r.language
all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEntities. x.language == f.language
all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEnds. x.relationship.language == f.language
all f in Formula, r in f.constrains. r.language == f.language
all e in End, m in e.max. m in e.min.*successor
all b in Bound. not b in b.^successor
all a in End, b in End, na in a.relationship.ends, nb in b.relationship.ends. (a != b and na != a and nb != b and na.entity == nb.entity) => (no a.name or a.name != b.name)
all t in Transformation. t.source in t.holder.*references.languages
all t in Transformation. t.target in t.holder.*references.languages
all m in RelationshipMapping, e in m.source.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == e.entity
all m in Mediation. some t in m.mediator.transformations, v in t.reverse. t.source in m.what.*references.languages and t.target in m.how.*references.languages
all m in EntityMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source
all m in EntityMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target
all m in RelationshipMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source
all m in RelationshipMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target
all m in RelationshipMapping, r in m.targets, e in r.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings, s in m.source.ends. n.source == s.entity and e.entity in n.targets
all v in Reverse, e in v.context. e.language == v.transformation.source or e.language == v.transformation.target
all d in Domain, l in d.languages. l.system == d.system
all d in Domain, r in d.references. r.system == d.system
all m in Mediation. m.what.system == m.system and m.how.system == m.system and m.mediator.system == m.system
all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p.type.language == i.language
all i in Interaction. i.output.language == i.language
all m in InteractionMapping, p in m.source.parameters. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == p.type
all m in InteractionMapping. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == m.source.output
all m in InteractionMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source
all m in InteractionMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target
all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p in i.first.*next
all i in Interaction, p in i.first.*next. p in i.parameters
all p in Parameter. not p in p.^next
all i in Interaction, p in i.primary. p in i.parameters
all e in Entity, c in e.comparison. c.language == e.language

all d in Deferred. (some d.entity and no d.relationship and no d.interaction) or (some d.relationship and no d.entity and no d.interaction) or (some d.interaction and no d.entity and no d.relationship)
all d in Deferred, x in d.entity. x.language == d.transformation.source
all d in Deferred, x in d.relationship. x.language == d.transformation.source
all d in Deferred, x in d.interaction. x.language == d.transformation.source
all d in Design. (some d.system and no d.context) or (some d.context and no d.system)
all a in Attachment. (some a.system and no a.context) or (some a.context and no a.system)
all e in Edit. (some e.addition and no e.change and no e.removal) or (some e.change and no e.addition and no e.removal) or (some e.removal and no e.addition and no e.change)
all e in Edit. e.author.target == e.history.target
all e in Edit, x in e.elements. x.target == e.history.target
all e in Edit, r in e.reverts. r.author == e.author
all e in Edit. not e in e.^following
all s in Selection, x in s.elements. x.target == s.session.target
all l in Link. l.source.view == l.view and l.target.view == l.view
all i in Item, c in i.children. c.view == i.view
all i in Item. not i in i.^parent
all c in Check. (some c.condition and no c.rule) or (some c.rule and no c.condition)
all v in Violation. v.rule in v.run.profile.rules
all v in Violation, s in v.subjects. s.snapshot == v.run.snapshot
all s in Section. not s in s.^parent
all p in Package, t in p.tags. t.catalog == p.catalog

notes: Inclusions are translated as the foundation defines them: the extension Language has its own copies of the included Entities and of the Relationships among them, and its Domain holds a Transformation mapping each to its copy.
Concept editors' operations are translated as op(EditSession, <concept>) -> Edit; the design gives full signatures for addEntity only.
Mediators' Transformations have no mappings yet: the client and platform Languages are still empty.
